CustomField.description: API name of the provenance DateTime field on this object (e.g. HS_Content_Changed__c), stamped by the before-trigger when a mapped field actually changes. It is the Salesforce side of the inbound newest-modified-wins comparison. Leave blank to fall back to LastModifiedDate -- but note the engine's own status DML bumps LastModifiedDate, so inbound will then almost never win a conflict.
CustomField.label: Content Changed Field
